CloudDocument.title: CloudDocument
CloudDocument.description: Metadata, OCR text, AI summary, and settings for a scanned PDF document synced to Firestore.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this document.

title.description: Display title of the scanned document.

folderId.description: Optional folder ID or empty string if in root.

category.description: Document category such as Scan, ID Card, Business Card, Receipt, Contract, or Imported.

pageCount.description: Total number of pages in the document.

fileSizeBytes.description: File size of the generated PDF in bytes.

ocrText.description: Combined OCR text extracted from all pages of the document.

aiSummary.description: AI-generated summary or insights from Gemini.

tags.description: Up to 10 short string tags classifying the document.

isFavorite.description: Whether the document is starred as a favorite.

isPasswordProtected.description: Whether the PDF has password protection enabled.

pageSize.description: PDF page size preset (A4, LETTER, ORIGINAL).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the document was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the document was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CloudFolder.title: CloudFolder
CloudFolder.description: User-created folder for organizing scanned documents.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this folder.

colorHex.description: Hex color accent for the folder badge.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the folder was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the folder was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/documents/{docId}.description: Per-user synced scanned documents containing metadata, OCR text, and AI analysis.

/users/{userId}/folders/{folderId}.description: Per-user synced folders for organizing documents.
